recorder.command: python3 autoresearch/run.py --lane browser-cpu --device eris --wait 900 --timeout 900 -- node apps/web/test/parity/record-sample.ts
recorder.oracle: journey-step snapshots: the Elmish model read through a React DevTools hook on every commit (elmish-probe.ts) plus the DOM a person sees (faces area, dialogs, toasts, notes) and the focused element
blind_spots: Messages are not observable (Elmish dispatch is private): a step is the model after an input, not the message sequence.
Commits between steps are counted, not kept.
Pixels are not compared: generated images, canvases and video are reduced to their elements; raw synthesis parity belongs to the numerics checks.
Blob URLs, durations and times are normalized; their values are not compared.
Photo bytes and latents never enter the goldens (files reduced to size and type, typed arrays to length).
recorder.privacy: no photo bytes, latents or typed inputs beyond the synthetic fixture words and seeds

rows.note: Golden spike sample flow: type a word, Generate, accept the download, Completed on CPU.
